authenticity_review: Significant AI artifacts dominate the composition. Primary defect is severe body fusion: the four raccoons merge into a single fur mass in the center without anatomical boundaries between individuals. Secondary defects include texture anomalies (airbrushed fur edges blending into background) and structural collapse in the bottom-right paw which lacks digit definition and melts into the floor surface. While facial features are rendered with high fidelity, the bodily integration is fundamentally flawed.
key_defects: Spatial relationship error: Raccoons are around/behind toy, not under it (Atom 2)
Counting error: Two toys present instead of one (Atom 3)
Severe fusion artifact: Raccoon bodies merge into indistinct mass (Authenticity)
Structural defect: Bottom-right paw lacks claw/digit definition, blends into floor (Authenticity)
Texture anomaly: Fur edges exhibit airbrushed glow rather than strand detail (Authenticity)
